This app ([app link](https://feracotommaso.github.io/living_SEB_review/shiny-app.html){target="_blank"}) allows using the *Living SEB Skills Project* materials to navigate and meta-analyse evidence from all cross-sectional SEB studies.

## Overview

The Living SEB App is an interactive Shiny application designed to explore, synthesize, and meta-analyse all available cross-sectional studies included in the Living SEB Skills Project. It provides a transparent, continuously updated interface to examine study characteristics, extract effect sizes, and run reproducible analyses in real time.

Built as part of a broader effort to create a living, open, and cumulative evidence base on Social, Emotional, and Behavioral skills (SEB), the app allows researchers, students, and practitioners to interact with the data without needing to write any R code.

➡️ Access the app here: <https://feracotommaso.github.io/living_SEB_review/shiny-app.html>

## What you can do with the app

-   Browse all included SEB studies with filters for samples, designs, measures, and variables.
-   Inspect effect sizes and metadata for every association extracted in the review.
-   Run on-the-fly meta-analyses (random/fixed models, moderators, subgroup analyses).
-   Download the dataset used in the app for further analysis in R or other tools.
-   Track updates as new studies are added to the living review.

## Features at a glance

-   📊 Interactive visualizations of effect sizes, uncertainty, and heterogeneity
-   🧮 Built-in meta-analytic models using robust and reproducible pipelines
-   🔍 Searchable database of SEB constructs, measures, sample characteristics
-   🔄 Continuously updated through the Living SEB Project workflow
-   📥 Export options for datasets and analysis outputs

## Background

The app accompanies the article:

Feraco, T., Calderan, M., and Pellegrino, G. (2026). The Living SEB Skills Project: A Living Resource for Review and Meta-Analysis of Social, Emotional, and Behavioral Skills. *European Journal of Personality*. [https://doi.org/10.1177/08902070261467477](#0){.uri}

Together with the broader Living SEB infrastructure, the app reflects a commitment to open science, research transparency, and dynamic evidence synthesis.
